Claim 13 (Currently Amended): A flexible respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the tube arrangement comprising: a flexible tube; a heater to heat the gas as it is delivered through the tube; a first connector provided to one end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a breathing mask; and a second connector provided to the other end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a CPAP device, said second connector including a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage and a second portion that provides integrated contact elements by which power is supplied to said heater, wherein said contact elements are adapted to be engaged with a power supply provided on the CPAP device for supplying power to said heater, __and wherein said second connector is structurally distinct from said first connector in design and function__.

Claim 14 (Currently Amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising __an insulating sheathing body that is separate from and does not form part of said second connector__.

Claim 15 (Currently Amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the insulating sheathing body is removably attachable to the flexible tube __and does not encompass said second connector__.

Claim 16 (Currently Amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the heater is integrated into the sheathing body __such that the heater is thermally coupled to the flexible tube through the sheathing body__.

Claim 17 (Currently Amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein said sheathing body includes a multi-layered design __comprising at least an inner insulating layer and an outer protective layer__.

Claim 18 (Currently Amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the tube is a heatable respiratory gas tube __having integrated heating elements distinct from said heater in said second connector__.

Claim 19 (Currently Amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the heater is integrated into the tube __and operates independently of said contact elements in said second connector__.

Claim 20 (Currently Amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein said second connector further includes a pressure measuring tube connection __that is fluidly isolated from said respiratory gas passage__.

Claim 21 (Currently Amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising a respiratory gas humidifier __positioned between said first connector and said flexible tube__.

Claim 22 (Currently Amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 21, wherein said humidifier is adapted to be connected to a water source via a humidification line __that is separate from said flexible tube__.

Claim 23 (Currently Amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 21, wherein said humidifier is in the form of a flexible tube piece disposed between the breathing mask and the respiratory gas tube __and includes a separate water inlet__.

Claim 24 (Currently Amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the flexible tube is made from a spirally reinforced plastic material __having a wall thickness of at least 1 mm__.

Claim 25 (Currently Amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the heater is an electrical resistance heater __positioned within said second connector__.

Claim 26 (Currently Amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage such that both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device, __and wherein said contact elements are made of a conductive material__.

Claim 27 (Currently Amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each __contact element__ is provided within the second portion.

Claim 28 (Currently Amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the first portion is tubular and the second portion extends outwardly from the first portion __in a radial direction perpendicular to the longitudinal axis of the gas passage__.

Claim 29 (Currently Amended): A connector for connecting a CPAP device to a respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the respiratory gas tube arrangement including a heater, the connector comprising: a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage; and a second portion that provides integrated contact elements by which power is supplied to the heater, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage such that both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device, __and wherein said contact elements are made of a conductive material__.

Claim 30 (Currently Amended): A connector according to claim 29, wherein each __contact element__ is provided within the second portion.

Claim 31 (Previously Presented): A connector according to claim 29, wherein the first portion is tubular and the second portion extends outwardly from the first portion.
